content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-134. - Advisement.
content.summary:
In cases where the records may be subject to expungement, the court may so advise
               the defendant. Failure to give such advisement shall not affect any judgment entered
               in the case but may be remedied by commencement of expungement proceedings.
(Code 1981, § 2-224; Ord. N…
